sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/conditions (Dolores Ranger District Road Status as of 2026-10-25)

values.note: 14 sites on a sloping hillside. Max RV size 35 ft; RVs and other wheeled equipment must fit in the parking spur (no overflow parking).

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/burro-bridge-campground ('The campground has 14 sites with a few shade trees on a sloping hillside above the West Dolores River.'; 'Equipment with wheels (RVs, campers, cars) must fit in the parking spur. There is not any overflow parking available.'; 'Max RV size = 35 ft'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Potable water in the main season only: none in the late-season extension (late September on) and no services at all October-May. No trash service; pack it out. Two horse bays.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/burro-bridge-campground ('Vault Toilet (2)'; 'Potable water is available at this site.'; 'Campground open from Sept. 27, through Nov. 22 ... No host, water or electric.'; 'Between October and May there are no services (water, trash pick up or restrooms).'; 'Two bays can accommodate 2 horses a day.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Mid-May through September; in 2026 extended from Sept 27 to Nov 22 (or until snow closes it) with no host, water or trash service.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/burro-bridge-campground (Seasons of Use 'Mid-May through September'; Current Conditions 'Campground open from Sept. 27, through Nov. 22, or if snow/weather closes campground. No host, water or electric.'; last updated September 25, 2026), read 2026-10-28

values.note: First-come only. recreation.gov lists it for on-site Scan and Pay (claim a site in person, then pay by QR code in the Recreation.gov app where available) or the fee tube.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/burro-bridge-campground ('All sites are first come, first serve.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165190 ('This location is available on a first-come, first-served basis only. Visitors are required to physically arrive at the campground to purchase and claim a site.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Up to 8 people per site. recreation.gov lists the same $23 for 2027.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/burro-bridge-campground ('Single Site: $23 per night / Maximum number of people per site: 8') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165190/rates (2026 and 2027 First-come seasons: 23), read 2026-10-28

note: San Juan NF (Dolores RD), on a sloping hillside with a few shade trees above the West Dolores River ~2 mi NE of Dunton: easy access to the Lizard Head Wilderness (Navajo Lake and Calico trails) but not easy access to the water. Reached on West Dolores Rd (FR 535, gravel) from Hwy 145 about 13 mi north of Dolores; the Forest Service says the road's last 6 miles, rejoining Hwy 145 north of Rico, are steep, narrow and not recommended for trailers, so come in from the Dolores end. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov 10165190 (Scan and Pay listing): confirmed 14 sites, 35-ft max RV, vault toilets, potable water (main season), FCFS only, $23 (2027 same). Added season note (mid-May-Sept; 2026 extension Sept 27-Nov 22 with no water) and facility/booking notes. Note trimmed of field restatements.
flags: Missing phone: Dolores Ranger District (970) 882-7296 (FS page Office Contact; shared with the Tres Rios BLM Field Office). recreation.gov's listing gives the concessionaire's (661) 702-1420.

Rig/road (criteria check, no problem found): agency max RV 35 ft, spurs must hold the whole rig. FR 535 is gravel; the only RV warning is the FS's 'the last 6 miles are steep, narrow, and not recommended for trailers' on the upper end toward Hwy 145 north of Rico. Approached from the Dolores end the campground is reached without that segment. No 4WD or high-clearance advice.

Status: open (late-season extension through Nov 22, 2026). FR 535 'West Dolores / Meadows' is Open on the San Juan NF road-status table as of 2026-10-25 (no gate, not regularly monitored) after the Oct 22-25 floods; the forest still urges visitors to avoid the forest where possible. Recheck before going.
Pin 37.78685,-108.06761 is ~20 m from the FS/rec.gov point (37.78701,-108.06771); the rec.gov listing has no per-site coordinates.
